{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check the number of duplicates in patient_id
duplicate_count = df['patient_id'].duplicated().sum()
print(f'Duplicate patient_id count: {duplicate_count}')

# Check the distribution of sample_seq per patient_id
sample_seq_stats = df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].max()
print(f'Unique patients after deduplication (by max sample_seq): {len(sample_seq_stats)}')

# Check how many rows have biomarker_baseline == -999
missing_baseline_count = (df['biomarker_baseline'] == -999).sum()
print(f'Rows with biomarker_baseline == -999: {missing_baseline_count}')"}
